decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed erection of a one bedroom, two-storey dwellinghouse by reason of its size, design and position would constitute an obtrusive feature in a prominent location, the openness of which is a valuable land characteristic. It would therefore be detrimental to the appearance of the streetscene and thereby would be contrary to adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the supplementary guidance Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed erection of a one bedroom, two-storey dwellinghouse would block the first floor flank window at No.40 Exeter Road. It would also give rise to the possibility to overlook, and detrimentally affect the outlook from, No. 2 Churchfield Avenue. It would therefore be contrary to Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the supplementary guidance Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: The erection of a one bedroom, two storey dwellinghouse.
